infrastructure.narrative: The POS network collapsed in Jun 2026, losing 16.03 lakh terminals — the steepest monthly decline on record — and contracting 15.8% year-on-year, the first double-digit contraction in the dataset. UPI QR deployment, by contrast, added 1.28 crore codes in Jun — the largest single-month gain on record — and now outnumbers POS terminals 79.9× to 1, the highest ratio in the dataset. The POS channel is in structural collapse, while UPI QR is capturing all incremental acceptance infrastructure deployment.
